items.statement: Residents who take part in monthly video review coaching will gain at least 1.5 more points on a blinded 5 to 25 global rating scale over one academic year than residents who do not, after adjustment for baseline score and training year.
items.rationale: The retrieved comparison found 1.8 points; the programme needs a local answer before committing consultant time.

items.statement: Coached residents will reach operating with passive help after fewer operations than uncoached residents.
items.rationale: Autonomy matters to residents but its evidence is unblinded.

summary: Two hypotheses; h1 selected with a blinded skill score as the outcome.
